answer: First, lock a sponsor: a newcomer needs an agent staking 200 units 15 epochs, locks 100. Then, watch 6 epochs: sponsors back at most 2 per epoch; stars get flagged. Finally, punish both sides: fraud forfeits the newcomer, slashes the sponsor 50%, bars rights 10 epochs, challenger earns 20. At dawn: 1,000 clones need 500 sponsors, 100,000 units; one ember burns the sponsor too; a pearl beats fakes. 30% caught means a joint loss of 45,000 units.
